name: schema-violation-with-dependents-on-an-interface
description: `with_dependents: true` applies to the removal of a whole component and to nothing else: on the remove of an interface it is refused `schema-violation`, before the model is staged, with the address the client wrote.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model, which declares `IDiagnosticService`; the refusal does not depend on what refers to it.

expected.notes: A member address with the flag (a port of a component) is refused the same way. The referrers of anything but a component are removed by the client's own operations.
